headline: Study finds connected cars share data widely with tech firms
summary: A Northeastern University study found that connected cars and their companion apps regularly share detailed data with trackers and some of the largest tech companies.

claims.statement: Connected cars and their companion apps regularly share detailed data with large tech companies and trackers.

sources.quote: Between the cars and their companion apps, you’re exposed to a lot of trackers.
Researchers at Northeastern University found vehicles and their companion apps regularly shared detailed data with some of the largest tech companies.

claims.statement: The research was conducted by Northeastern University.
